author: ojiudezue
title: S1 'don't fight manual' guard superseded: URA reclaims manual unless one of four gates holds; it was secretly the only thing protecting borrows
summary: The v3.8.0 rule that S1 never writes a preset over a manual hold ("that's the arrester's job") is replaced in W1-B. S1 now reclaims manual unless (a/b) a person-protected hold is on (Temp Arrester Override or any immune person), (c) the arrester's grace/compromise is in flight, (d) the arrester is disabled (passive mode: detects, never reverts), or (e) the zone has a live borrow row in the existing excursion registry. Provenance tracking, reclaim delay, kill switch and a separate BORROW_LOCK were all dropped; problem 4 (reclaim after TAO/immune sunset) closes for free.
why: The rule predates borrows and assumed the arrester owns every manual, but Carrier turns every raw setpoint write into a manual hold and the arrester declines manuals at ~zero delta, so URA-caused manuals had no owner: 88-661 min strands and 22/22 nudge-echo lockouts. Operator: "Its outdated design... We didn't even know borrows would come back as manual then." Tracing it showed the guard was also an undocumented safety dependency: the governed-excursion lease gate was stripped on 2026-08-21 as 'zero value' precisely because the guard shielded borrows, so removing it without gate (e) would let S1 stomp every nudge.
alternatives_considered: Keep the guard and build provenance (classify each manual as URA-owned vs human, reclaim only URA-owned with a delay + kill switch) — REV 4 plan; dropped as complexity serving a wrong premise

Separate BORROW_LOCK reading four arrester timers with its own cap + NM — collapsed into gate (e) after verifying every nudge/compromise timer is preceded by begin_excursion so the registry row covers the window
Revive the stripped lease gate — rejected; gate (e) is a read of the existing row, discharged by its own stale_ts bound, sweep and boot audit
implications: The rule lives only at the S1 decision site (plus the arrester's existing detection path for nudge-wins booking); operator forbade adding logic to borrow code or the emit_* write funnels, and resume-then-pin stays because it is a Carrier quirk, not the guard. ~160 extra Carrier writes/day from post-nudge reclaims. After live validation: delete the excursion HIGH-1 manual-skip + parked D3, repurpose the lockout ledger to deferral reasons, close HVAC-PRESET-LOCKOUT-ESCAPE-1 and HVAC-ZONE1-MANUAL-OSCILLATION-1. Any unbuilt plan whose safety argument leaned on the guard (off-phase honesty INV #2, W2 fast path) must be re-proven. 15 docs bannered SUPERSEDED; state-of-play §9e + §10 C25.
revisit_trigger: Post-W1-B: any S1 preset write landing while a borrow row, person-protected hold, arrester grace/compromise, or passive arrester is active; or a URA-caused manual lasting > one decision tick with all gates clear.
